floorPlans.introduction: Explore the published apartments in Towers 1 and 2 and the townhouse layouts. Where a sheet covers more than one unit group, the area shown spans its printed total areas. Match the unit reference and level on the plan.
floorPlans.note: Plans and dimensions are approximate and subject to developer revisions. Drawings are not to scale; shown furnishings and generic view legends do not guarantee a particular unit’s outlook or sale inclusions.

review.images: All8 exact official gallery assets visually reviewed. Own complete golf-side building render placed first for detail/card/hero; own pool/balcony and5 interior scenes retained. Emaar also publishes some of these scenes on the related Grove Ridge release page; no independent claim of unique photography is made.
review.location: Own brochure physical4 and official linked regional map reviewed. Published Vista Ridge and Grove Ridge coordinates are identical; this is shown as a shared developer reference, not an independently surveyed building entrance. Exact coordinates retained without guessing.
review.floorPlans: All36 title/area panels visually reviewed: Tower1 physical4–18, Tower2 physical20–37, townhouses39–41. Multiple unit-group tables preserved and sqft min/max computed from every printed TOTAL AREA, including lower panels. Exact type suffixes, tower/sheet/unit references retained. Full unedited sheets and original41pagePDF preserved.
